presets.title: Where does the calendar come from?

socialSchools.label: Social Schools
socialSchools.step1: Open Social Schools in a browser at app.socialschools.eu. The iPhone app cannot do this: it adds the calendar straight to Apple Calendar and never shows you the link.
socialSchools.step2: Go to the Agenda tab and click Abonneren (Subscribe), top right.
socialSchools.step3: Click the link in the dialog to copy it, then paste it below.
socialSchools.note: No school holidays in it? Then the school has not imported its year calendar yet — worth asking them about.

parro.label: Parro
parro.step1: Open Parro at talk.parro.com or in the app and go to Instellingen (Settings).
parro.step2: Choose Agenda koppelen (Link calendar), then Aan de slag (Get started).
parro.step3: Click the link to copy it, then paste it below.
parro.note: Kynite refreshes this calendar every hour. Parro says Google Calendar sometimes takes up to a week.

magister.label: Magister
magister.step1: Log in to Magister in a browser — the app cannot do this — and open the menu under your name.
magister.step2: Go to Instellingen › Agenda delen and generate a link.
magister.step3: Copy the link and paste it below.
magister.note: Lessons only, and only this week plus the two after it. Regenerating the link kills the old one, so you have to replace it here too.

somtoday.label: Somtoday
somtoday.step1: Have your child open Somtoday, tap the menu and go to Instellingen (Settings).
somtoday.step2: Choose Agenda and walk through “Aan de slag”.
somtoday.step3: Copy the long link and paste it below.
somtoday.note: If the option is not there, the school has switched it off. Timetable appointments only — no homework or tests.

zermelo.label: Zermelo
zermelo.step1: Your child has to log in to the Zermelo WebApp themselves: a parent account cannot generate the link.
zermelo.step2: Menu top left › Instellingen › iCal-link genereren.
zermelo.step3: Copy the link and paste it below.
zermelo.note: This week and next week only, and only lessons your child is enrolled in.
